title: Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management, B.S. — Commercial Recreation and Tourism Management Option (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: Pre-2024 curriculum, built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan (Commercial Recreation and Tourism Option, University Park) and Program Requirements tabs, cross-checked row-by-row against the raw table HTML (not WebFetch's summary) because the page's get_text() output interleaves Fall/Spring columns and silently drops colspan='2' filler rows if read as plain text -- confirmed byte-identical to the archived 2023-24 bulletin (RPTM-2023.json), diffed programmatically against both 2023-24 and the live 2026-27 page. Real, verified differences from RPTM-2026.json: (1) 'RPTM 120' has no 'or 120S' alternative in 2022-23/2023-24 -- RPTM 120S did not yet exist as an alternate section; it first appears starting the 2024-25 bulletin. (2) The university-wide Gen Ed 'Integrative Studies'/'Exploration' relabeling (adopted 2024-25) had not yet happened: Semester 3's second flexible slot is a literal 'GH' domain requirement (not 'Inter-Domain'), and Semester 4's two flexible slots are literal 'GA'/'GN' domain requirements (not two untagged 'Exploration' slots) -- this is the same universal PSU Gen Ed program redesign other majors' historical years hit, not an RPTM-specific change. (3) Semester 5's final slot is a plain, unenforced 'Elective' in 2022-23/2023-24; the bulletin's own Fall-Third-Year row shows a second real 'Supporting Course in Consultation with Academic Adviser' slot there only starting 2024-25 -- a genuine, verified curriculum tightening, not a labeling change. (4) The CAS 283/CMPSC 203 item (Semester 6) is a flat 3 credits in 2022-23/2023-24 (2024-25 on, the bulletin lists it as a '3-4' variable-credit range with a footnote letting CMPSC 203 double as the GQ slot); Semester 6 here keeps the 2022-23 bulletin's real row shape instead -- two full 'Supporting Course' pool slots plus a trailing 1-credit 'Elective', which the raw table's colspan='2' rows confirm sum to the bulletin's own stated 14-credit Spring-Third-Year subtotal. (5) The Semester 5 GWS item's real course-option list for this era still includes the legacy 'CAS 100' section code (not just CAS 100A/100B/100C) -- dropped from the bulletin only for the 2026-27 edition. Total credits 120-121 per the bulletin's own footer, vs. 120-122 for 2024-26 -- consistent with finding (3) above (an added required Supporting Course, offset by First-Year-Seminar's 1-2 credit range only existing 2024+). Program Requirements tab (major-specific '46-47 credits', the 'select 6 credits' business-elective pool, and the RPTM/CAS/CMPSC course sequence) is otherwise unchanged from the 2026-27 page -- no prerequisite-chain or total-credit-minimum differences found, so no department course-catalog page was re-fetched (matching this session's convention of only re-verifying prereqs where a real difference is suspected). Wired Supporting Course slots to the same department Supporting Course List subset RPTM-2026.json already uses (RPTM/STAT/CMPSC/CAS scope) -- that list is the department's live current-course page, not bulletin-year-specific, so it is unchanged across years exactly as BRANCH_CAMPUS_FINDINGS.md's finding #2 establishes for course descriptions generally. STAT 200 (or 100) is kept hard-wired to the Fall-Second-Year GQ slot, mirroring RPTM-2026.json's own established modeling choice (RPTM 433W's real, unresolved 'and a 3-credit course in statistics' prereq half), since that is a course-level prereq fact, not a catalog-year curriculum difference.
